title: Student Loan Payoff Myths

scenes.text: A $30,000 student loan at 4.5%—should you rush to pay it off?
Many think paying any loan early is always the smartest financial move.
scenes.label: Pay loans early always best

scenes.text: If you can earn more than the loan’s interest elsewhere, investing may grow wealth faster than the savings from early repayment.
scenes.label: Invest if returns > loan rate
scenes.query: investment return vs loan interest comparison

scenes.text: Compare your loan rate to potential investment returns before deciding.
scenes.label: Rate Comparison
scenes.sub: Use a simple calculator to weigh options.
scenes.query2: loan interest vs stock return tool

scenes.text: Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.

description: Uncover why paying off a student loan early isn’t always the optimal choice. Get a quick comparison tool tip. Follow for more evidence‑based money habits.
